findings.title: Macaca fascicularis: IUCN category VU
findings.point: Macaca fascicularis (long-tailed macaque) is assessed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
findings.query: Macaca fascicularis long-tailed macaque IUCN Red List Endangered

sources.title: IUCN upholds long-tailed macaques' endangered status ...
sources.label: open web (not an official source)
sources.quote: The IUCN escalated the conservation status of the species, Macaca fascicularis, from vulnerable to endangered in 2022 after macaques poached from the wild were found to have been laundered into breeding farms in Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam supplying laboratories abroad.
sources.why: The quote explicitly states the IUCN escalated the species' status from vulnerable to endangered in 2022.
sources.quote_check: exact text of the Tavily-extracted source
